groups.title: Go gRPC Setup
groups.question: Walk through how you set up code generation for a gRPC service in Go.

followUps.protoc-gen-go & protoc-gen-go-grpc: Why does Go need two separate plugins to generate gRPC code, and why should you pin their versions?
followUps.Module Path & go_package Option: What goes wrong when the go_package option does not match your module path?

groups.title: Implementing Go Servers
groups.question: Explain how you start and stop a gRPC server in Go safely.

followUps.RegisterXxxServer & net.Listen: What happens if you forget to register one of your services before calling Serve?
followUps.Graceful Stop vs Force Stop: Why should a deploy use GracefulStop with a timeout instead of Stop?

groups.title: Go Client Patterns
groups.question: Explain how a Go service should create gRPC clients and pass request context through calls.

followUps.Connection Reuse & grpc.Dial: Why should a Go service create one client connection at startup and share it?
followUps.Context, Deadlines & Cancellation: What happens downstream if a handler does not pass its incoming context to a gRPC call?

groups.title: Go Concurrency & gRPC
groups.question: Explain how concurrency and error handling work in a Go gRPC service under heavy load.

followUps.Goroutines Per Stream: Why can unbounded concurrent streams become a problem, and how would you limit them?
followUps.Error Wrapping with status.Error: What does the client see if a Go handler returns a plain fmt.Errorf error?
